citations.quote: MANILA — Rene Baterbonia was not, in any way, connected to University of Santo Tomas before his passing, but it was with the España-based team that his bereaved family found solace as they continue to cope with their loss.
Rene’s parents, Rovelyn Baterbonia and Rene Baterbonia Sr., were present at the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball matches on Wednesday and visited UST ahead of its game against De La Salle University.

Growling Tigers head coach Pido Jarencio revealed that the Baterbonias decided to visit the team after Rovelyn found comfort in seeing UST forward Koji Buenaflor, whom the family felt bore similarities to Rene.
“Pumunta kay Koji kasi parang lookalike ni Rene. Niyakap, umiiyak yung nanay.”
“Si Koji, naaalala nila na parang anak nila, kaya kami naman, yun lang ang nao-offer namin sa kanila.”

citations.quote: Rene Baterbonia’s mom, Rovelyn, was on the sidelines of the UAAP Season 89 game between the University of Santo Tomas and De La Salle University on Wednesday at the Mall of Asia Arena.
During their visit to the venue, Rovelyn also had a photo with UST’s Koji Buenaflor, who some believe bears a resemblance to the late Rene.

“Rene, even if you’re not here, I am still supporting the call for justice for your death. Thank you, UST, for allowing me to have a photo with someone who looks like you. This game’s for you,” Rovelyn said in Filipino in a Facebook post.
“It was a touching moment earlier. His mother came to us and went to Koji because Koji looks like Rene. She was reminded of Rene, embraced Koji as if he were Rene, and started crying,” Jarencio said.
“I simply told her, ‘You are here with us, and we will dedicate all our games to your son, to Rene.’ She was very happy.”

“We’re not doing this for show or grandstanding. They came to us and to Koji, and they were reminded of Rene because he looked like their son. So that’s what I could offer them: every game will be dedicated to Rene Baterbonia. That came from our hearts,” he added.
